services.name: A2A Interaction Trace
services.description: Evaluate one A2A task from structured lifecycle events. Receive completion, delivery, ordering, reported latency, schema validity, an execution score, evidence confidence, and risk flags. Both reports cost 6 credits, floor 5. Catalog, health, schemas, samples and quotes are free. Agents call the API directly; local order status does not prove credit settlement.
limitations: The report does not verify credit settlement.
A single trace does not establish global reputation.

services.name: A2A Interaction Risk Report
services.description: Return the same task metrics and risk flags as Interaction Trace, with fixed bilingual explanations of each triggered flag and the report scope. Both reports cost 6 credits, floor 5. Catalog, health, schemas, samples and quotes are free. Agents call the API directly; local order status does not prove credit settlement.
limitations: Risk Report uses the same execution metrics as Interaction Trace.
Paying for Risk Report does not increase evidence confidence.
The report does not verify credit settlement or establish global reputation.
